critical_code_review_comments: The centralised api.js refactor appears to have been done with regex and stripped code inadvertently. Two P0 ReferenceError bugs in a single sweep (AdminFAQDashboard's `services` and BusinessApps' `valueCards/aiFeatures/painPoints/deploymentOptions`) suggest more silent removals could exist. Recommend a repo-wide grep for identifiers used in JSX but never declared/imported (e.g. an ESLint no-undef pass over /app/frontend/src) before shipping.

ServiceDetail.jsx (line 3) still does `import axios from 'axios'` and uses axios directly instead of the shared `api` instance from lib/api.js — inconsistent with the refactor's stated goal. It works because BACKEND_URL is re-exported, but the whole point of the central client is to route through it.
BusinessApps.jsx canonicalUrl is hardcoded to https://www.fidelislogic.com/... — fine for SEO but should ideally derive from env.
cookieConsent + GA gtag injection wiring looks correct in code; couldn't fully assert window.gtag transition post-click due to test env quirks but structure is sound.

rca_of_the_issue: BusinessApps /solutions/business-apps crash RCA: BusinessApps.jsx references JavaScript identifiers `valueCards`, `aiFeatures`, `painPoints`, `deploymentOptions` inside JSX .map() calls at lines 160, 196, 221, and 326 respectively. None of these identifiers are declared as consts in the component body, none are imported from any module, and none exist in /app/frontend/src/data/siteContent.js either. The result is a runtime ReferenceError when React tries to render the Value Proposition section (first use is on line 160). Root cause: the recent mechanical regex refactor to route all axios calls through lib/api.js appears to have deleted large const array blocks in this file (same pattern as the recently-fixed AdminFAQDashboard.jsx which was missing `import { services }`). Fix: reconstruct the 4 arrays from git history or /app/memory/, or import them from a new data file.
